top_5_current_affairs.title: Mission Divyastra: Agni-V with MIRV Technology
top_5_current_affairs.summary: India successfully tested the Agni-V missile equipped with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology, allowing a single missile to deploy multiple warheads at different targets.
key_points: Indigenously developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO).
Significantly enhances India's strategic nuclear deterrence capability.
Places India among a select group of nations (USA, Russia, China, France, UK) with MIRV capabilities.

top_5_current_affairs.title: Delimitation Commission and Article 82
top_5_current_affairs.summary: Renewed national debate surrounding the upcoming delimitation exercise expected post-2026 based on the fresh census, highlighting federal dynamics between North and South Indian states.
key_points: Article 82 mandates the readjustment of Lok Sabha seats after every census.
The 84th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 froze the seat allocation until the first census after 2026.
Key concerns include federal imbalance, representation proportionate to population control achievements, and Southern state seat share.

top_5_current_affairs.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)
top_5_current_affairs.summary: Strategic and economic reviews of the proposed IMEC project aimed at boosting connectivity and trade integration between India, the Arabian Gulf, and Europe.
key_points: Unveiled during the G20 Summit in New Delhi.
Consists of East Corridor (connecting India to Gulf) and Northern Corridor (connecting Gulf to Europe).
Serves as a counter strategy to China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) and promotes regional integration.

top_5_current_affairs.title: Environmental Assessment of the Great Nicobar Development Project
top_5_current_affairs.summary: Ongoing legal and ecological scrutiny over the ₹72,000-crore mega-infrastructure project on Great Nicobar Island involving an International Transshipment Port, airport, and power plant.
key_points: Concerns raised regarding the displacement of particularly vulnerable tribal groups (PVTGs) like Shompen and Nicobarese.
Threats to critical biodiversity habitats of Giant Leatherback Sea Turtles and Nicobar Megapode.
Strategic counter balance against China's presence near the Malacca Strait.

top_5_current_affairs.title: RBI Framework for Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) - e-Rupee
top_5_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) expands the pilot scope of the Digital Rupee (e₹) by introducing offline capability and programmability features.
key_points: Offline functionality enables transactions in areas with limited or no internet connectivity.
Programmability allows targeted delivery of government subsidies and corporate benefits.
Differentiates CBDC (legal tender issued by RBI) from decentralized private cryptocurrencies.
